decisions.reason: The electronic music box with a church motif extends the firm's established music-box and lighting know-how, so the firm can interpret early sales results and refine the product with its in-house workshops.
A wooden nativity stable sits at the core of the firm's traditional Christmas woodcraft knowledge, so it is easy to assimilate, improve and keep in the seasonal range.

The modern incense smoker builds on the firm's long-held figurine expertise while serving its strategy of blending tradition with contemporary design, so the firm can learn from early market feedback rather than drop it.
